object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make a link whose acknowledged commit is the target's last change, then commit a revision of the target; acknowledge a revision, then commit a revert to the earlier text; acknowledge a revision on a branch, then replay it on a new base by squash, rebase and cherry-pick; make a link to an object ID with no object. Expected: the link reads OK only while its acknowledged commit is the target's last change; after each later commit that changes the target, the revert and each replayed commit included, it reads suspect with that commit as the last change; the link to a missing object never reads OK.
